name: Nora AI Publisher: AI Blog Writer & Auto Publishing
author: decaffeinatedfullyee695dfe1a

sections.description:
Nora AI Publisher writes complete blog posts for your WordPress site and publishes them for you. It finds what people are asking about your subject, writes an article that answers each question in its first lines, adds a cover image, tags and a category, and puts the post on your site.

There is no API key to create and nothing to set up on a server. Install it, say what your site is about, press one button.

Key Features (Free Version)

  • No API key needed. No OpenAI, Groq or image account to create. Everything is included.
  • Any subject. Describe what your site is about in your own words.
  • Finds the hot topics for you. It searches the live web for what people in your field are looking up and talking about right now, scores each idea out of 10, and writes about the top-scoring one you have not covered yet. Your readers get what is trending now, not last year’s news.
  • Complete articles that read like a person wrote them. 1,500 to 2,000 words with a hook that pulls the reader in, clear headings, relatable examples and a warm, everyday voice. Written to avoid the stiff, stock phrases that give AI text away.
  • Written to be quoted. Headings phrased as questions, a direct answer right under each one, and a FAQ at the end. This is the format Google and AI assistants lift answers from.
  • Your language. English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Russian, Japanese or Hebrew.
  • Cover image included. A fitting image is added and set as the featured image.
  • Tags and category. Tags are created for each post and the best matching category on your site is chosen.
  • Links to your earlier posts. New articles link to the ones already published, using their real addresses.
  • Publish on autopilot, or review first. Articles go live on their own at the time you choose, or wait as drafts so you read them before anyone else does. On the free plan they go out on the 1st and 15th of each month.
  • 8 writing tones. Casual, professional, friendly, academic, inspirational and more.
  • Your own keywords. Add up to 15 keywords to steer what gets written.
  • One-click Generate Now. A finished post in about two minutes.
  • Safe by design. It never asks for your WordPress password. It uses its own access key, which is removed when you deactivate the plugin.
  • 2 posts a month, free.

Premium Features (Paid Plans)

Upgrade from inside the plugin, billed monthly through Stripe:

  • More posts. 8, 16 or 60 posts a month.
  • Schedule all your future articles. Pick your days and your time once. Every article after that is written and published automatically, with nothing left for you to do.
  • Several languages at once. The same article published in 2, 3 or up to 10 languages, each as its own post.
  • Natural AI translation. On Growth and Pro, each language version is rewritten by AI so it does not read like a machine translation.
  • AI-made cover images. An image created for the article instead of a stock photo.
  • More keywords. Up to 150 keywords on Pro.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin. It connects itself, with no key to paste.
  2. Say what your site is about and add a few keywords.
  3. Choose your language and a tone.
  4. Press “Generate Now”. Your first article is on your site in about two minutes.
  5. On a paid plan, pick your days and let it publish on its own.

Perfect For

  • Bloggers who cannot write every week
  • Small business sites that need a living blog to be found
  • Coaches, consultants and practitioners
  • Agencies running several client blogs
  • Sites that publish in more than one language
  • Anyone who wants to show up in Google and in AI answers without learning SEO

Honest About AI Search (AEO and GEO)

Answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) are about being quoted by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google’s AI answers. Nobody can promise that an assistant will quote your site, and we do not. Google’s own 2026 guidance says that showing up in AI answers is still good SEO: pages that can be read and that answer the question plainly. That is what this plugin writes. It does not add llms.txt files or schema tricks, because the research shows they do not help.

What Nora AI Publisher does NOT do

  • It does not read or change the existing content of your site. It creates new posts, and looks up which of its own earlier posts are published so it can link to them.
  • It does not require your WordPress login password. It creates its own dedicated, revocable Application Password on activation, and removes it again if you deactivate the plugin.

External services

This plugin connects to the Nora AI Publisher API (hosted at blog-api-v2-ashen.vercel.app), a service operated by Nora Coaching, to provide its core functionality. This is required for the plugin to work. There is no local or offline mode. Articles and images are created on that service, which is why you need no AI account of your own.

What is sent to this service:

  • Your site’s URL, an admin username, and a WordPress Application Password created by the plugin (used so the service can publish posts to your site on your behalf).
  • Your settings: the subjects you describe, keywords, tone, languages, publishing mode and schedule (used to write articles that fit your site and to publish them when you asked).
  • Your site name and admin email (used to register your account).

What the service sends back:

  • Generated article titles, body content, tags and cover images, which are published to your site through the standard WordPress REST API.

By activating this plugin, you agree to this data being sent to and processed by the Nora AI Publisher API in order to provide the plugin’s functionality.

If you choose to upgrade to a paid plan, clicking an “Upgrade” button on the settings screen sends your site’s unique tenant ID to Stripe (https://stripe.com), a third-party payment processor, to create a checkout session. You are then redirected to Stripe’s own secure, hosted checkout page to enter payment details. The plugin itself never sees or stores your card information. This only happens if you actively choose to upgrade. It is not required to use the free plan.

Stripe terms of service: https://stripe.com/legal/consumer
Stripe privacy policy: https://stripe.com/privacy

Privacy policy: https://blog-api-v2-ashen.vercel.app/privacy
Support: support@noracoaching.com
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to Plugins, then Add New.
  3. Search for “Nora AI Publisher”.
  4. Click “Install Now”, then “Activate”. The plugin creates its own Application Password and registers your site. There is nothing to configure.

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nora-ai-publisher directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.

First Article

  1. Open the “Nora AI Publisher” menu in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  2. Say what your site is about, choose your language and tone, and save.
  3. Press “Generate Now”.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin really free?

Yes. The free plan gives you 2 complete posts a month, with cover image, for as long as you like. No credit card.

Do I need an OpenAI or other API key?

No. Unlike most AI writing plugins, there is no key to create, no account to open elsewhere and no usage bill. It is all included.

Can it write about my subject?

Yes. You describe your site in your own words, for example “home gardening, growing vegetables” or “family law, divorce advice”, and add keywords if you like. Topics and articles follow that.

Can I review posts before they are published?

Yes. Choose “Save it as a draft” on the settings screen and read each post before it goes live.

Will AI assistants like ChatGPT quote my articles?

Nobody can guarantee it. What raises your chances is a page they are allowed to read, on a subject you really cover, with a plain answer near the top. That is how these articles are written.

Does Google penalize AI-written posts?

Google’s rules target pages produced in bulk with no value for the reader, however they were written. A few articles a month on your real subject, which you read and correct, are a different thing. We recommend reading every post and adding your own experience.

Which languages are supported?

English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Russian, Japanese and Hebrew. You choose one main language on the free plan, and up to 10 languages on Pro. Articles are written in English first and then translated. Free and Starter use machine translation. Growth and Pro use AI translation, which reads more naturally.

When are articles published?

On the free plan, when you press “Generate Now”, and automatically on the 1st and 15th of each month. On paid plans you choose the days and the time, in your site’s timezone.

Is the content unique?

Yes. Each article is written from scratch, and the plugin avoids subjects it has already covered on your site. Always check facts before publishing.

Does it need my WordPress password?

No. It creates its own Application Password on activation, which you can revoke at any time. It is removed automatically when you deactivate the plugin.

Does it work on every WordPress site?

It is tested on self-hosted WordPress 5.6 or newer that is reachable on the internet. It does not work on a local test site or in WordPress Playground, because the service has to reach your site to publish. WordPress.com is not tested yet. Multisite networks are not supported in this version.

How do I stop it?

Deactivate the plugin. Its access key is removed and nothing more is published.

What does it cost to upgrade?

Starter is $9.99 a month, Growth $16.99 and Pro $39.99. Cancel any time.

Who is behind it?

Nora AI Publisher is built and maintained by Nora Coaching. Support: support@noracoaching.com
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: write about any subject. Describe your site in your own words instead of choosing from a fixed list.
  • New: choose the language of your articles, from 12 languages.
  • New: save articles as drafts and review them before publishing.
  • New: paid plans can choose the days and time of automatic publishing, and publish each article in several languages.
  • Improved: articles link to your earlier posts using their real addresses, whatever your permalink settings.
  • Improved: up to 10 tags per post instead of 29.
  • Improved: “Generate Now” can be used more than once a day, and a run that produced no post no longer counts against your monthly posts.
  • Fixed: a stray “—” line and an automatic “Visit us at” footer no longer appear in posts.

1.1.0

  • Added paid plan upgrades (Starter, Growth, Pro) directly from the settings screen, billed monthly through Stripe.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: automated topic discovery, AI article generation, AI cover images, and scheduled publishing.
